parent.rewards.form.unitExplainEnd: . She builds up units by practising, and you decide how much practice earns one unit. Example: with a unit of “hours of TV” and “20 minutes per unit”, 40 minutes of practice earns 2 hours of TV.
parent.rewards.form.rewardUnitHelp: The thing she’s earning, e.g. hours of TV, minutes of tablet, or pounds.

parent.rewards.form.rewardPerUnitHelp: How many units to award each time she reaches the amount above.
parent.rewards.form.penaltyPerMissedDay: Units taken away on a missed day
parent.rewards.form.penaltyPerMissedDayH: If she does no practice on a day, subtract this many units. Set to 0 for no penalty.
parent.rewards.form.focusHelp: Pick the tables you want practised most. A day only counts if she practised one of them. Leave all off to count any practice.
